prompt: Use case: historical-scene / game environment illustration. Create a dedicated production background artwork for a Chinese Three Kingdoms narrative strategy game, Yiling retreat rescue map. Wide landscape 16:9. A beautifully hand-painted late Han military landscape map blending Chinese ink wash shanshui, fine gongbi landscape detail and atmospheric cinematic environment painting. Top-down oblique bird's-eye illustrated terrain, NOT a UI mockup, NOT a schematic. The whole image is continuous geography on subtly warm aged silk paper: layered wooded cliffs, smoky mountain passes, a broad winding muted jade river curving across the lower half, tributaries, realistic tiny wooden boats, tiny Han tents, narrow ochre retreat trails organically branching across valleys. Ink charcoal, warm taupe, desaturated pine green and jade, restrained ember-orange distant burning camps in upper right. Painterly tactile brushwork, mist, paper fibres, exquisite tiny terrain details, harmonious dark midtone readability; no huge black blocks, no harsh vignette. Nine natural points of interest distributed with ample quiet breathing room for later text overlays (do not draw labels): upper left around 18% x 26% mountain road; upper middle around 50% x 26% north bank ferry; upper right 83% x 26% smoky fire ridge; middle left 17% x 50% forest foothill route; centre 50% x 50% surrounded small tent camp at road junction; middle right 83% x 50% rear guard gorge; lower left 22% x 74% dense southern woodland clearing; lower middle 50% x 74% small upstream flotilla and bank landing; lower right 82% x 74% distant river port and outbound boat. Flowing trails link landmarks naturally, no rectangular route grid and no straight dashed lines. Leave especially top 10% and bottom 10% quieter for game navigation. This is an imagined strategic scene, not a claim of geographic reconstruction. Absolutely no lettering, Chinese characters, numbers, titles, legend, seals, badges, pins, glowing circles, borders, frame, panels, cards, menus, user interface or text. Finished premium game map art, not generic vector or diagram.
scope: Independent Yiling rescue demo; imagined terrain, not historical geographic reconstruction.
